name: Abhimanyu Nag
description: Abhimanyu is a MITACS Fellow in Mathematics at the University of Alberta. He holds a BSc from the University of Alberta and has worked in Security, Risk and Consensus with Nethermind, Pantera Backed TanX, Catalysis Labs as well as Antler's Chainrisk Labs as Chief Scientist. His research has been published by IEEE, Springer, and Financial Cryptography, and he was cited in the Ethereum Research Paper at the age of 20 for EIP 5133. His main work is in the intersection of cryptography and economics.
